**What it would do**
One or two sentences, from the point of view of someone using Ledge.

**What it needs from Ledge**
The data it reads, what it changes, the apps or services it talks to. Add-ons can only use capabilities the
Ledge app supports, so a new one is planned here before it's built.

**Are you building it?**
Yes / No / Would like to
